title: Managed Backup: capacity amendment
content:
For Managed Backup, the capacity amendment basis governs contract amendment.

## Policy clauses

The contract status is active or suspended.

The source amendment request is approved and customer-authorized.

The customer files a signed amendment request before the agent applies the approved attributes.

The request external source reference identifies the signed amendment; its related approved review carries the affected exact values and effective service interval start.

Request and review events preserve those effective attributes.

Keep status unchanged, use the new tier only for service intervals beginning at the request effective time, and retain old tier and effective price on earlier meter and invoice records.

Refuse any change above resource count limit or when completed amendment count has reached monthly accepted amendment limit.

Completed amendment requests count once; pending, rejected or cancelled requests do not change the holding.

Signed commitments keep their recorded expiration and remaining contractual liability unless the signed amendment explicitly replaces them.

## Authoritative evidence

Before contract amendment, system records must establish this condition for the proposed action: The contract status is active or suspended.

The evidence identifies Contract reference, Status. Match the action to that evidence by Contract reference; these references identify the same proposed business objects.

The recorded contract state for this action must be active or suspended.

Before contract amendment, system records must establish this condition for the proposed action: The source amendment request is approved and customer-authorized.

The evidence identifies Event reference, Status, Customer request reference, Source business subtype. Match the action to that evidence by Event reference, Customer request reference; these references identify the same proposed business objects.

UTC calendar month containing the fixed handling time. Count completed request events of source business subtype amendment for this holding; cancelled and rejected requests do not count.

## Basis Q&A

**What is the stated entry basis?** The contract status is active or suspended.

## Hypothetical case

A hypothetical approved amendment becomes effective at a recorded instant. A service interval beginning before that instant retains its earlier tier; one beginning at that instant uses the new tier. Neither branch changes contract status.
